subject: Order not delivered
email: My order #4521 was supposed to arrive on Monday but I still have not received it.
reply: Dear Arjun, we apologize for the delay in delivering your order #4521. Our logistics team is checking with the courier and you will receive an updated delivery date within 24 hours. Thank you for your patience.

subject: Package delayed
email: It has been 10 days and my package is still showing in transit. Where is it?
reply: Dear Priya, we are sorry that your package is taking longer than expected. We have escalated it to our courier partner and will share the latest tracking update with you by tomorrow.

subject: Damaged item received
email: My package arrived damaged. The box was torn and the mixer jar is cracked.
reply: Dear Rahul, we are very sorry for the inconvenience. Please share a photo of the damaged product and we will arrange a free replacement immediately.

subject: Broken phone screen
email: The phone I received has a cracked screen right out of the box.
reply: Dear Sneha, we sincerely apologize. We will arrange a pickup and send you a brand-new replacement after a quick verification. No extra charges will apply.

subject: Refund not received
email: I returned my shoes two weeks ago but I have not received my refund yet.
reply: Dear Vikram, we apologize for the delay. Your return has been received and the refund is being processed. It will be credited to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.

subject: Want my money back
email: The product is not as described. I want a full refund.
reply: Dear Ananya, we are sorry the product did not meet your expectations. Please raise a return request from My Orders, and once we receive the item, a full refund will be issued within 5 business days.

subject: Cancel my order
email: Please cancel my order #7812. I ordered the wrong size.
reply: Dear Karthik, your order #7812 has been cancelled successfully. Since it was prepaid, the refund will reach your account within 3-5 business days.

subject: Cancellation request
email: I want to cancel my order because I found it cheaper elsewhere.
reply: Dear Meera, we have received your cancellation request. If the order has not been shipped yet, it will be cancelled within a few hours and you will receive a confirmation email.

subject: Payment deducted twice
email: My bank account was charged twice for the same order.
reply: Dear Suresh, we apologize for the inconvenience. We have verified the duplicate charge and the extra amount will be refunded to your account within 5-7 business days.

subject: Payment failed but money deducted
email: My payment failed during checkout but the money was deducted from my account.
reply: Dear Divya, we are sorry for the trouble. Failed transactions are automatically reversed by the bank within 5-7 business days. If not, please share the transaction ID and we will help you.

subject: Cannot log in
email: I am not able to log in to my account. It says invalid password.
reply: Dear Naveen, please use the Forgot Password option on the login page to reset your password. If the issue continues, reply to this email and we will unlock your account.

subject: Change email address
email: How can I change the email address linked to my account?
reply: Dear Lakshmi, you can change your email address from Account Settings > Profile > Edit Email. A verification link will be sent to the new address.

subject: Laptop warranty
email: Does the HP laptop I bought come with a warranty? How do I claim it?
reply: Dear Ajay, yes, your HP laptop comes with a 1-year manufacturer warranty. You can claim it at any HP authorised service centre with your invoice.

subject: Is this phone waterproof?
email: Before buying, I want to know whether the Galaxy S24 is waterproof.
reply: Dear Pooja, the Galaxy S24 is IP68 rated, which means it is water and dust resistant up to 1.5 metres for 30 minutes. Please avoid salt water and hot water.

subject: Very poor service
email: This is the third time my order is late. Your service is very disappointing.
reply: Dear Ramesh, we sincerely apologize for the repeated delays. This is not the experience we want for you. We have flagged your account for priority delivery and added a Rs. 200 coupon as a goodwill gesture.

subject: Rude delivery agent
email: The delivery person was very rude to my parents.
reply: Dear Kavya, we are truly sorry for this experience. We have reported the incident to our delivery partner and strict action will be taken. Thank you for bringing this to our attention.

subject: Exchange size
email: The shirt I received is too small. Can I exchange it for a larger size?
reply: Dear Manoj, yes, you can exchange it within 7 days of delivery. Go to My Orders, select the item and choose Exchange. Our courier will pick it up and deliver the new size.

subject: Return wrong product
email: I received a different product from what I ordered. I want to return it.
reply: Dear Swathi, we apologize for sending the wrong item. We will arrange a free pickup and ship the correct product to you within 3-4 days.

subject: Great service
email: I got my order a day early and the packaging was excellent. Thank you!
reply: Dear Harish, thank you so much for your kind words! We are delighted that you had a great experience. We look forward to serving you again.

subject: Happy with product
email: The headphones are amazing. Thanks for the quick delivery.
reply: Dear Nithya, thank you for sharing your feedback! We are glad you love the headphones. Happy listening!

subject: Missing item
email: My order had 3 items but only 2 were in the box.
reply: Dear Gokul, we are sorry that an item was missing. We have raised a complaint with our warehouse and the missing item will be shipped to you within 48 hours at no cost.

subject: Wrong address
email: I entered the wrong address. Can you change it before delivery?
reply: Dear Revathi, if the order has not been shipped, we can update the address. Please reply with the correct address and pin code, and we will update it right away.

subject: Coupon not working
email: The coupon SAVE10 is not getting applied at checkout.
reply: Dear Deepak, we apologize for the trouble. The SAVE10 coupon is valid on orders above Rs. 999. Please check your cart value. If it still fails, we will apply the discount manually.

subject: Late refund for cancelled order
email: I cancelled my order 8 days ago and still no refund.
reply: Dear Asha, we are sorry for the delay. Your refund was initiated on the day of cancellation and should reflect within 1-2 business days. Please share your bank reference if it does not arrive.
